blocks.x: I got no bets. Talking about people's religions -- I don't know. But they have some awful ones -- they keep a rattle snake and let them bite them and they worship snakes and stuff.
You have a lot of -- I guess you've seen practically all the United States when you have --

Practically. I guess there's a few places I haven't been. I mean -- I'm trying to think of where I haven't been. I haven't been in Alaska. And I don't intend to go there anymore now. Let's see -- (inaudible) a state I haven't been in.

I didn't spend any time in North and South Dakota -- I can't say I've been there. But I've been there. What states -- I can't think of any states that I haven't been in. Can't think of any I don't think.
I've been in New Mexico. Yeah, I have been there but only just driving through, yeah. Don't remember staying there.
